summary: End-to-end verification of the NEW advanced Player Dashboard + Map upgrades (self-hosted GTA V tiles, custom icon blips, live moving players, precise game-coord placement). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass — /api/server/status shape, /api/server/players-live returns 8 players with position CHANGE between two polls 2.5s apart (movement confirmed), /api/auth/me with seeded JWT returns full new multi-character schema (2 chars each with cash/bank/crypto/status{5 vitals}/inventory/skills/licenses/properties/vehicles/transactions), Discord login URL well-formed, unauth/invalid tokens correctly 401. Frontend (Playwright on public URL with seeded JWT): dashboard-welcome + both char-switch buttons render; clicking char-switch-1 changes cash from $3,366 → $5,760 (data actually swaps). All 5 vital bars (health/armor/hunger/thirst/stress) and all 4 money cards (cash/bank/crypto/networth) render. Tabs overview/inventory/bank/assets all switch content (inventory-grid renders 7 tiles with data-testid inv-item-* + carry-weight bar; bank-transactions list renders; assets shows properties+vehicles). Map: 18/18 self-hosted tiles load from same origin /tiles/atlas/, satellite and road toggles switch URL to /tiles/satellite/ and /tiles/road/ (18/18 loaded each). Six div.blip elements on 'All'; filters yield exactly 2/2/2/6 for police/safe/business/all. Live toggle is ON by default with 8 pblip markers and label 'Live Players (8)'; toggling off removes all 8 markers. Clicking a blip opens popup showing category ('BUSINESS'), name ('Benny's Original Motorworks'), description and game coords 'x:-205 y:-1310'. ZERO console errors/warnings during the entire flow. Screenshot confirms atlas tiles fill the container edge-to-edge at zoom=4 and blips sit on land in sensible regions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user auto-migrates legacy single-character docs to the new multi-character schema on read — clean, backward compatible.
ServerMap.jsx uses key={mapStyle} on TileLayer to force reload on style change and errorTileUrl for graceful degradation — both good.
Live players polled every 3s via setInterval; interval is cleared on unmount and on showLive toggle — no leak.
gameToLatLng calibration constants (SCALE/XC/YC) are centralised in a CAL object with an inline tuning comment — easy to adjust later.

Dashboard.jsx and server.py are both approaching ~430 lines; still under the 700-line threshold but consider splitting Dashboard into DashboardVitals / DashboardTabs subcomponents if more features are added.
server.py _make_character seeds random data on every request path that triggers migration — deterministic seeding (e.g. seeded random by discord_id) would make QA repeatable, but not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advanced Dashboard + Map upgrades are fully verified. Self-hosted tiles live in /app/frontend/public/tiles/{atlas,satellite,road}/ (zoom 3-5). If tile pyramid or CRS is changed, re-run the map portion of the Playwright script. The auth/me schema now has top-level 'characters' array — old top-level keys (character, licenses, ...) no longer exist and legacy docs are migrated on first read.
